name: Violet Aurora
source:
Violet initially appears as a human but becomes a ghost after her death. She is Buni’s friend and serves as a support character throughout the loops Buni experiences. While the narrative establishes her as highly important to the story, she does not appear frequently across the chapters; nevertheless, she remains connected to nearly every character.

She is in the same class as Buni, Misaki, Cassie, and Matrie: class XI Bakeneko. Violet holds the top academic ranking, achieving perfect scores in every subject. She is the type of person who excels effortlessly, succeeding without apparent effort. She was formerly friends with Rian and was acquainted with Cassie, Matrie, and Anzheilla until a tragedy occurred.
